text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sarajevo press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- No visible signs in Mostar that Bosnian Croat mini-state of Herceg-Bosnia has dissapeared as required under deal that should have taken effect on August 31 .
- Former food production company "Agrokomerc" from Bosnia's northwestern Bihac area renamed "Agrokar". It restarts chicken breeding with injection of 24 million German Marks from Turkish "Kargroup".
- International food, agriculture and textile fair to be held in Sarajevo September 3-7.
